verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say one platform covers small projects through demanding production. Projects start with drag-and-drop or anonymous CLI deploys, and the same platform offers a "production-grade database" and security "at any scale", from a personal portfolio to a banking site. But no evidence explicitly shows that the same core APIs and primitives carry from prototype to massive scale without rearchitecting. The "any scale" claim is about security only. Missing for 10: an explicit scale-continuity guarantee for functions, storage and APIs; documented scaling limits or behavior at high load; independent or hands-on reports of apps growing to large scale without rearchitecting or migrating.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the same core APIs and primitives from prototype through massive scale, without rearchitecting or migrating platforms as usage grows

citations.quote: Secure your project at any scale—whether you need the security of a banking site with Netlify Advanced Security or simple password protection for a personal portfolio site.
Instantly provision a production-grade database with Netlify Database or use Blobs as a simple key/value store or lightweight database.
Drop your project folder and deploy in seconds.
